reserveReview.rationale: The September 30 review of eligible collateral remains historical. Supplementary October 2, 2026 review: Metronome's September 16 recovery update reports that the July 30 shortfall was fully closed and a surplus established through treasury-funded buybacks and an $8 million USDC loan against treasury wstETH. The update also states that the synth swap remains closed indefinitely. This issuer-reported recovery does not supply a complete current msUSD-only collateral allocation, an independently scoped reserve-to-liability report, or an unconditional future recovery guarantee. Eligible multi-synth collateral is not a measured 100% msUSD allocation; NC-136 remains basket-needs-split, and compositionAsOf is unchanged. Supplemental source check 2026-10-09 by Sol curation campaign 2026-10-09 (Lane51Tokenised): the supported-assets and deposit-cap documentation still describes eligible assets and limits, while the September 16 recovery update promises a separate detailed report and continued itemized transparency work. These reviewed surfaces do not disclose a complete dated msUSD-only claim allocation reconciled across the multi-synth book, treasury debt, float and collateral. No deposit cap, buyback amount or pooled collateral balance has been substituted for measured reserve weights. The scoped campaign classification records the separate research timestamp without refreshing the historical composition.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: Historical eligible collateral envelope; supported-assets and July 30 underbacking post-mortem re-read 2026-09-30, without a new measured composition
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: A complete current msUSD-only collateral allocation is not established by the reviewed sources. Cross-margin multi-synth pooling prevents treating raw DepositToken supplies as msUSD-only composition. The July 2026 post-mortem documented approximately 4.57 million msUSD without matching debt positions; the September 16 issuer update reports that shortfall closed and a surplus established. Neither historical amount is treated as a current measured collateral allocation.

Vesper pool contracts underlying va-token collateral

custodyProfile.reviewer: Kimi P2 reserve cohort rc-2 (lead buidl-blackrock)
custodyProfile.uncertainty: Collateral is pooled per asset in non-custodial DepositToken contracts with per-user debt tracked separately; plain assets (ETH, WBTC, USDC, DAI, FRAX) sit idle in those contracts, while Vesper va-token collateral (vaETH, vaUSDC, vaFRAX, and similar) represents positions whose underlying Vesper pools deploy capital into yield strategies by design, hence conditional reuse. The 2026-10-01 protocol and deployment-documentation review establishes technical per-asset contract separation, but did not establish enforceable legal segregation or bankruptcy-remoteness rights under ruling D09. Legal rehypothecation terms and a primary-source custody agreement were not located in that review.
